caption: The drawing depicts a wooden dresser with four large drawers and two smaller drawers on top, all adorned with ornate gold-colored handles. The dresser has a rich, reddish-brown wood finish with visible wood grain patterns. Sitting atop the dresser is a large framed mirror with a wavy, decorative edge, matching the reddish-brown wood of the dresser. The mirror’s reflection is rendered with shading to suggest light and depth. The dresser stands on four short, rounded feet with slight scrollwork at the bottom. The main image is bordered by a thin red line. In the upper left and upper right corners, there are two smaller line-drawing sketches: the one on the left shows a simple front elevation of the dresser and mirror, labeled with arrows indicating height measurements; the one on the right shows a side view of the dresser with the mirror tilted backward, also in line-drawing style. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, and the artwork is signed "DEL 156-1 ERNEST TOWERS JR." at the lower right corner.
